method: Levelized Cost of Hydrogen (LCOH) with ammonia shipping pathway
definition: End-to-end cost model from renewable electricity to delivered H2 in Europe via NH3
assumptions: Ammonia as hydrogen carrier for ocean shipping
invariants: CRF-based annualization of all capital costs
WACC applied uniformly to all components within a region
Complementarity factor of 1.15 for hybrid PV/wind
non_negotiable_steps: Calculate hybrid LCOE from PV and wind
Size electrolyzer, battery, and H2 storage
Add ammonia synthesis costs at source
Add ammonia cracking costs at destination
Compare against European domestic production benchmark
deviations_from_GeoH2: Simplified hybrid optimization (not hourly dispatch with PyPSA)
Latitude-based shipping cost (not detailed maritime routing)
No pipeline transport option (ammonia trucking only)
